workflows.description: Complete language, host and account setup; labels, roles, required state and errors are announced; secret fields are labelled and masked.
Inspect account and capability table; account, environment, permission, supported/unknown capability and refresh time are announced.
Start, inspect, pause/resume/cancel research/replay without focus theft; result tables and evidence links remain reachable.
Read intent, instrument, quantity, estimated/max cost, risk, alternatives and expiry; changed/stale intent produces an explained conflict.
Review and activate bounded policy; actual active version, scope and host are announced.
Reach Block new exposure by normal keyboard navigation and documented shortcut; accepted request, durable block and in-flight uncertainty remain distinct.
After network/host loss, stale state and last evidence time are announced without claiming cancel or flatten completion.
Copy values and decision explanations; inspect partial fills, fees, protection and correction lineage without chart dependence.
Complete installer/update/rollback and restore flow by keyboard; errors expose recovery state without secrets.
